tourismTax.label: Tourism taxes collected and remitted on behalf of hosts
tourismTax.definition: "Total tourism taxes collected and remitted on behalf of hosts in 2024", as listed by Airbnb for selected states only (19 states and Washington, DC); rounded to the nearest million.

jobsSupported.label: Estimated jobs supported (Airbnb IMPLAN analysis)
jobsSupported.definition: Jobs supported by Airbnb guest spending in Canada, from Airbnb's internal analysis using the IMPLAN economic impact model ('over 105,000 jobs'). Estimate.

jobsSupportedOE.label: Jobs supported (Oxford Economics study)
jobsSupportedOE.definition: Jobs supported by the economic activity Airbnb generates, from the Oxford Economics study Airbnb commissioned for 10 Asia-Pacific countries ('Airbnb commissioned Oxford Economics ... to assess the impact of Airbnb’s ecosystem on communities throughout Asia Pacific').

impactGdp.label: Estimated total contribution to GDP from travel on Airbnb
impactGdp.definition: Airbnb's own estimate: "Estimated economic impact based on an internal analysis using the IMPLAN economic impact model which assesses direct, indirect and induced economic activity." State map column 'Total Contribution to GDP'. An estimate, not a reported transaction.

impactJobs.label: Estimated jobs supported (Airbnb IMPLAN analysis)
impactJobs.definition: Jobs supported by Airbnb guest and host activity, from Airbnb's internal IMPLAN-model analysis (U.S. state map column 'Total Jobs Supported', published rounded, e.g. '12.2K'; Canada from the Canadian 2024 release). Estimate.

impactTax.label: Estimated total tax generated
impactTax.definition: "Estimated taxes associated with economic activity generated by Airbnb stays" (state map column 'Total Tax Generated'), from the same internal IMPLAN analysis. Broader than, and not comparable to, tourismTax.

notes: usStates: 2024 tourism taxes collected and remitted on behalf of hosts for the 19 states plus Washington, DC that Airbnb lists in its newsroom post (it also lists British Columbia, Ontario and Quebec in CAD, which are provinces and not used). Airbnb's 2024 U.S. economic impact release (news.airbnb.com/economic-impact-2024-us) links a 50-state map (GDP contribution, jobs supported, tax generated; internal IMPLAN estimates), but its data is an Airbnb-authored Flourish chart hosted on flo.uri.sh with the rows inside a <script> block, so it fits none of the allowed host types and cannot pass the quote verifier; those 50 rows were held out of this file. Countries: jobs supported in 9 Asia-Pacific countries from Airbnb's Oxford Economics-commissioned 2024 study (company-commissioned; Thailand is 'Nearly 110,000', recorded as 110,000). Vietnam's page reports 2025, not 2024, and is omitted. Canada's 'over 105,000 jobs' (plus) is from Airbnb's internal IMPLAN analysis (company-published). Local-currency GDP figures per country were not recorded, to avoid mixing currencies. No 2024 host-earnings-by-state data was found in the time available. 10-K Item 2 names only the San Francisco headquarters.
